resources.string: A ball that rolls with your phone.
Tilt the phone and the ball rolls. Hold the Glyph button to charge a ring, let go to fire it.
Without it the toy will not show up on the back of your phone. Add Glyph Template to your Glyph Toys.
Tilt the phone. Hold, then let go.
Turn on Glyph Template in Glyph Toys
Tilt the phone: the ball rolls and bounces off the edge
Hold the Glyph button to charge the rim, let go to fire the ring
